system.description: You may enter a controlled frenzy at will by winning or tying a Simple Test, choosing your own targets while the frenzy otherwise plays out normally; failure drops you into an uncontrolled frenzy instead. You may also regain composure during an uncontrolled frenzy with a Self-Control Challenge, spending a Willpower Trait each turn to hold onto that control until Willpower runs out or the frenzy is ended normally.
